question: Rana Tigrina is the scientific name of which animal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Frog.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The scientific name of the **frog** is Rana tigrina.
 
• Rana tigrina is now known as **Hoplobatrachus tigerinus**.
 
• Frogs characteristically have **smooth skin, strong hind legs for leaping, and webbed feet**.
 
• Most reproduce in water, laying eggs that grow into **larvae (tadpoles).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/296b968e1d0af64e4f16ae3f81a345a892c493bd25d54123b8db0ae865b7224b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The tiger** is the largest living cat species and a member of the **genus Panthera.**​ 
 
• The scientific name of the tiger is **Panthera Tigris.**
 
• **The wolf **(**Canis lupus**), also known as the gray wolf or grey wolf, is a large canine native to** Eurasia and North America.**
 
• Leopard, (**Panthera pardus**), , also known panther, large cat closely related to the** lion, tiger, and jaguar.**
